exposure: Maternal asthma (categorized by status: ever, current, active)
Maternal asthma phenotypes (HBE/HBN, HBN/LBE, HBE/LBN, LBE/LBN)
cohort: Singleton live-birth pregnancies in Alberta between October 2009 and December 2018.
finding: Women with any history of asthma, particularly current and active asthma, are at a higher risk of preterm birth, low birth weight, and C-sections, with specific asthma phenotypes also showing increased risks.
mod_finding: Maternal asthma was associated with an increased risk of C-section deliveries, with the highest risks observed in active asthma, followed by current and ever asthma.
